title: Domestic radicalization
hook: The Profiles of Individual Radicalization in the United States (PIRUS) database “contains deidentified individual-level information on the backgrounds, attributes, and radicalization processes of nearly 1,500 violent and non-violent extremists who adhere to far right, far left, Islamist, or single issue ideologies in the United States” — including the Klu Klux Klan, the Taliban, and the Animal Liberation Front, among others.
